payload.reason: The evidence indicates that face tracking, identification, and localization are integrated components of a multimodal system for audio-visual meeting transcription, suggesting they are not programmed by hand but rather function as part of an automated process.

claims.text: Face tracking, identification, and localization are integrated in a multimodal system for speaker attribution in meeting transcription.
The system utilizes continuous speech separation and combines multiple cues from audio and video modalities for robust performance.
Face tracking and identification are performed at a tracklet level, indicating an automated process rather than manual programming.
